verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for a SaaS API and SDK product like Unstructured, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers telemetry, analytics collection, or any opt-out control. The VPC/dedicated-instance data isolation and SOC 2/GDPR/HIPAA compliance claims address data handling, not whether users can disable usage tracking.
